head_commit.message: Render statusline context as a meter (#17170) Problem: The statusline reported context as an “X% left” value, which could be mistaken for quota, and context usage was included in the default footer. Solution: Render configured context status items as a filling context meter, preserve `context-used` as a legacy alias while hiding it from the setup menu, and remove context from the default statusline. It will still be available as an opt-in option for users who want to see it.
